title: Password Reset
policy: Employees can reset their own password via the self-service portal at any time. If locked out after 5 failed attempts, contact IT to unlock the account manually. No approval required.
action: Allow self-service password reset. If the account is locked after 5 failed attempts, route the request to IT for manual unlock.

title: VPN Access
policy: VPN access is granted automatically to all full-time employees. Contractors require manager approval. VPN credentials expire every 90 days and must be renewed by the employee.
action: Full-time employees receive automatic VPN access. Contractors require manager approval. Expired credentials should be renewed by the employee.

title: Laptop Replacement
policy: Laptops are eligible for replacement after 3 years of service, or earlier in case of verified hardware failure. Requests must be raised at least 2 weeks in advance.
action: Check laptop age and hardware condition. Early replacement due to hardware failure requires verification.

title: Software Installation
policy: Standard software listed in the approved catalog can be self-installed. Non-catalog software requires IT Security review, which takes 3–5 business days.
action: Allow self-installation for catalog software. Route non-catalog software requests to IT Security.

title: Printer Troubleshooting
policy: For printer issues, first check the printer queue and restart the print spooler. If the issue persists, log a ticket with the printer's asset tag.
action: Check printer queue and restart the print spooler. If unresolved, create an IT ticket with the printer asset tag.

title: Email Mailbox Quota
policy: Default mailbox quota is 25GB. Employees nearing quota should archive old mail. Quota increases beyond 25GB require manager approval and are capped at 50GB.
action: Ask the employee to archive old mail. Quota increases require manager approval and cannot exceed 50GB.

title: Guest Wi-Fi Access
policy: Guest Wi-Fi credentials are valid for 24 hours and can be generated by any employee from the front-desk kiosk. No IT ticket required.
action: Direct the employee to the front-desk kiosk to generate guest Wi-Fi credentials.

title: Expense Software Access
policy: Access to the expense management tool is granted by Finance, not IT. IT can only assist with login or technical issues once an account already exists.
action: For new access, contact Finance. IT can assist only with technical or login problems for existing accounts.

title: Security Incident Reporting
policy: Any suspected phishing email, malware, or unauthorized access attempt must be reported immediately to security@veridian-corp.example and should not be forwarded to other employees.
action: Immediately escalate to Security. Tell the employee not to forward the suspicious message to other employees.

title: Work-From-Home Equipment
policy: Employees working remotely more than 3 days per week are eligible for a one-time home office equipment allowance. Manager sign-off and Finance processing are required. IT handles shipping after approval.
action: Verify remote work is more than 3 days per week. Route for manager sign-off and Finance processing. IT handles shipping after approval.
